figures.caption: Fig. 2: Experimental procedure. The user teaches by physically guiding the EE along a 3D trapezoidal path. The green and red markers show the start and end points, respectively. External interaction is highlighted by a green circle, and the inset image shows the user’s applied “push” motion (arrow).

Fig. 4: Experiment result: (a,i) 3D FDM learned path, (a.ii–a.iv) estimation error of the learned path, reproduction error, and reproduction under perturbation for a trapezoid-shaped path; (b.i–b.iv) corresponding results for a ‘W’-shaped path. Shaded areas indicate the period of interaction, with the corresponding impact highlighted in circles. All values are expressed in cm.

Fig. 3: Experiment result: (a,i) 3D FDM learned path, (a.ii–a.iv) estimation error of the learned path, reproduction error, and reproduction under perturbation for an ‘S’-shaped path; (b.i–b.iv) corresponding results for a near ‘O’-shaped path. Shaded areas indicate the period of interaction, with the corresponding impact highlighted in circles. All values are expressed in cm.
